# Per-layer EMA centroid similarity heatmap: computes per-layer per-token
# EMA scores across multiple gamma values, generates heatmap visualizations.

import argparse
import os
import sys
import time

import numpy as np
import torch
import torch.nn.functional as F

import matplotlib
matplotlib.use("Agg")
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt


def parse_args():
    p = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="Per-layer EMA score heatmap analysis")
    p.add_argument("--model", default="/root/carc/models/DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-14B")
    p.add_argument("--device", default="cuda:1")
    p.add_argument("--seq-len", type=int, default=4096)
    p.add_argument("--gammas", nargs="+", type=float, default=[0.5, 0.7, 0.9])
    p.add_argument("--output-dir", default="/root/carc/results")
    p.add_argument("--heatmap-bins", type=int, default=256)
    p.add_argument("--seed", type=int, default=42)
    p.add_argument("--dtype", default="bf16", choices=["fp16", "bf16"])
    p.add_argument("--collect-only", action="store_true", help="Only collect data, skip plotting")
    p.add_argument("--plot-only", action="store_true", help="Only plot from existing data")
    return p.parse_args()


def load_wikitext_tokens(tokenizer, seq_len, seed=42):
    from datasets import load_dataset
    ds = load_dataset("wikitext", "wikitext-2-raw-v1", split="validation", trust_remote_code=True)
    texts = [item["text"] for item in ds if item["text"].strip()]
    full_text = "\n".join(texts)
    tokens = tokenizer(full_text, return_tensors="pt", add_special_tokens=False).input_ids[0]
    torch.manual_seed(seed)
    if len(tokens) > seq_len:
        max_start = len(tokens) - seq_len
        start = torch.randint(0, max_start, (1,)).item()
        tokens = tokens[start:start + seq_len]
    print(f"WikiText-2 tokens: {len(tokens)} (requested {seq_len})")
    return tokens.unsqueeze(0)


def compute_ema_scores(key_cache, value_cache, gamma, num_layers, device):
    seq_len = key_cache[0].shape[2]
    all_scores = np.zeros((num_layers, seq_len), dtype=np.float32)

    for layer_idx in range(num_layers):
        kl = key_cache[layer_idx].float().to(device)
        vl = value_cache[layer_idx].float().to(device)

        anchor_k = kl[:, :, 0, :].clone()
        anchor_v = vl[:, :, 0, :].clone()

        layer_scores = torch.zeros(seq_len, device=device)

        for t in range(seq_len):
            kt = kl[:, :, t, :]
            vt = vl[:, :, t, :]

            cos_k = F.cosine_similarity(kt, anchor_k, dim=-1)
            cos_v = F.cosine_similarity(vt, anchor_v, dim=-1)

            score = ((cos_k + cos_v) / 2).mean()
            layer_scores[t] = score

            anchor_k = gamma * anchor_k + (1 - gamma) * kt
            anchor_v = gamma * anchor_v + (1 - gamma) * vt

        all_scores[layer_idx] = layer_scores.cpu().numpy()

        if (layer_idx + 1) % 8 == 0:
            print(f"  gamma={gamma}: {layer_idx+1}/{num_layers} layers done")

    return all_scores


def downsample(matrix, target_bins):
    num_layers, seq_len = matrix.shape
    if seq_len <= target_bins:
        return matrix
    bin_size = seq_len / target_bins
    result = np.zeros((num_layers, target_bins), dtype=np.float32)
    for b in range(target_bins):
        start = int(b * bin_size)
        end = int((b + 1) * bin_size)
        result[:, b] = matrix[:, start:end].mean(axis=1)
    return result


def plot_single_heatmap(scores, gamma, output_path, seq_len, heatmap_bins):
    ds = downsample(scores, heatmap_bins)
    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(16, 8))

    im = ax.imshow(ds, aspect="auto", cmap="viridis", interpolation="bilinear",
                   origin="lower")
    ax.set_xlabel("Token Position")
    ax.set_ylabel("Layer Index")
    ax.set_title(f"Per-layer EMA Centroid Similarity ($\\gamma$={gamma})")

    n_xticks = 8
    xtick_pos = np.linspace(0, heatmap_bins - 1, n_xticks)
    xtick_labels = [f"{int(x * seq_len / heatmap_bins)}" for x in xtick_pos]
    ax.set_xticks(xtick_pos)
    ax.set_xticklabels(xtick_labels)

    ytick_pos = list(range(0, ds.shape[0], 4))
    ax.set_yticks(ytick_pos)
    ax.set_yticklabels(ytick_pos)

    cbar = fig.colorbar(im, ax=ax, shrink=0.8)
    cbar.set_label("EMA Similarity Score")

    plt.tight_layout()
    fig.savefig(output_path, dpi=200, bbox_inches="tight")
    plt.close(fig)
    print(f"Saved: {output_path}")


def plot_comparison(all_scores, gammas, output_path, seq_len, heatmap_bins):
    n = len(gammas)
    fig, axes = plt.subplots(n, 1, figsize=(16, 4 * n + 2), sharex=True)
    if n == 1:
        axes = [axes]

    vmin = min(downsample(s, heatmap_bins).min() for s in all_scores.values())
    vmax = max(downsample(s, heatmap_bins).max() for s in all_scores.values())

    for idx, gamma in enumerate(gammas):
        ds = downsample(all_scores[gamma], heatmap_bins)
        im = axes[idx].imshow(ds, aspect="auto", cmap="viridis", interpolation="bilinear",

        ytick_pos = list(range(0, ds.shape[0], 8))
        axes[idx].set_yticks(ytick_pos)
        axes[idx].set_yticklabels(ytick_pos)

    n_xticks = 8
    xtick_pos = np.linspace(0, heatmap_bins - 1, n_xticks)
    xtick_labels = [f"{int(x * seq_len / heatmap_bins)}" for x in xtick_pos]
    axes[-1].set_xticks(xtick_pos)
    axes[-1].set_xticklabels(xtick_labels)
    axes[-1].set_xlabel("Token Position")

    cbar.set_label("EMA Similarity Score")

    print(f"Saved: {output_path}")


def print_stats(all_scores, gammas):
    print("\n" + "=" * 80)
    print("PER-LAYER EMA SCORE STATISTICS")
    print("=" * 80)

    for gamma in gammas:
        scores = all_scores[gamma]
        num_layers = scores.shape[0]
        print(f"\n--- gamma = {gamma} ---")
        print(f"{'Layer':>5} {'Mean':>8} {'Std':>8} {'Min':>8} {'Max':>8} {'Range':>8}")
        print("-" * 50)

        layer_means = []
        for l in range(num_layers):
            row = scores[l]
            m, s, mn, mx = row.mean(), row.std(), row.min(), row.max()
            layer_means.append(m)
            if l % 4 == 0 or l == num_layers - 1:
                print(f"{l:>5} {m:>8.4f} {s:>8.4f} {mn:>8.4f} {mx:>8.4f} {mx-mn:>8.4f}")

        layer_means = np.array(layer_means)
        strongest = np.argsort(layer_means)[-5:][::-1]
        weakest = np.argsort(layer_means)[:5]

        print(f"\nStrongest EMA signal (highest mean): layers {strongest.tolist()}")
        print(f"Weakest EMA signal (lowest mean):   layers {weakest.tolist()}")
        print(f"Overall: mean={layer_means.mean():.4f}, std across layers={layer_means.std():.4f}")

    os.makedirs(args.output_dir, exist_ok=True)

    print(f"\nAll outputs saved to {args.output_dir}/")

# Composite signal test: combine EMA similarity with attention/recency signals
# for improved KV cache eviction decisions.

import argparse
import sys

import torch


def parse_args():
    p = argparse.ArgumentParser(
        description="Composite signal test: EMA + attention/recency for KV eviction"
    )
    p.add_argument("--model", default="/root/carc/models/DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-14B")
    p.add_argument("--device", default="cuda:1")
    p.add_argument("--seq-len", type=int, default=2048)
    p.add_argument("--num-samples", type=int, default=20)
    p.add_argument("--dataset", default="wikitext", choices=["wikitext", "c4"])
    p.add_argument("--budget", type=int, default=1024, help="KV cache budget")
    p.add_argument("--gamma", type=float, default=0.9, help="EMA decay")
    p.add_argument("--alpha", type=float, default=0.5,
                   help="Weight for EMA signal in composite (1-alpha for secondary)")
    p.add_argument("--signal-mode", default="ema+recency",
                   choices=["ema+recency", "ema+attention", "ema+attn+recency"],
                   help="Which signals to combine")
    p.add_argument("--output", default="/root/carc/results/composite_signal_results.json")
    p.add_argument("--seed", type=int, default=42)
    p.add_argument("--dtype", default="bf16", choices=["fp16", "bf16"])
    p.add_argument("--dry-run", action="store_true", help="Validate config and exit")
    return p.parse_args()


class CompositeScorer:
    """Combines EMA centroid similarity with attention/recency signals."""

    def __init__(self, alpha=0.5, signal_mode="ema+recency"):
        self.alpha = alpha
        self.signal_mode = signal_mode

    def compute_recency_scores(self, cache_length, grace_window=175):
        scores = torch.linspace(1.0, 0.0, cache_length)
        scores[-grace_window:] = 0.0
        scores[0] = 0.0
        return scores

    def compute_attention_scores(self, attention_weights):
        avg_attn = attention_weights.mean(dim=0)
        return 1.0 - (avg_attn / (avg_attn.max() + 1e-8))

    def composite_score(self, ema_scores, cache_length, attention_weights=None):
        if self.signal_mode == "ema+recency":
            secondary = self.compute_recency_scores(cache_length)
        elif self.signal_mode == "ema+attention":
            assert attention_weights is not None
            secondary = self.compute_attention_scores(attention_weights)
        elif self.signal_mode == "ema+attn+recency":
            assert attention_weights is not None
            attn_score = self.compute_attention_scores(attention_weights)
            recency_score = self.compute_recency_scores(cache_length)
            secondary = (attn_score + recency_score) / 2
        else:
            raise ValueError(f"Unknown signal_mode: {self.signal_mode}")

        secondary = secondary.to(ema_scores.device)
        return self.alpha * ema_scores + (1 - self.alpha) * secondary


def main():
    args = parse_args()

    print(f"Composite Signal Test")
    print(f"  Model: {args.model}")
    print(f"  Signal mode: {args.signal_mode}")
    print(f"  Alpha (EMA weight): {args.alpha}")
    print(f"  Gamma (EMA decay): {args.gamma}")
    print(f"  Budget: {args.budget}")
    print(f"  Seq len: {args.seq_len}")
    print(f"  Samples: {args.num_samples}")

    if args.dry_run:
        scorer = CompositeScorer(alpha=args.alpha, signal_mode=args.signal_mode)
        dummy_ema = torch.rand(args.budget)
        dummy_attn = torch.rand(48, args.budget) if "attention" in args.signal_mode else None
        result = scorer.composite_score(dummy_ema, args.budget, dummy_attn)
        assert result.shape == (args.budget,), f"Unexpected shape: {result.shape}"
        print(f"\n[DRY RUN] CompositeScorer validated OK")
        print(f"  Output shape: {result.shape}")
        print(f"  Score range: [{result.min():.4f}, {result.max():.4f}]")
        sys.exit(0)

    print("\nFull experiment not yet implemented. Use --dry-run to validate.")
    sys.exit(1)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
